description: This file contains unit tests for the PDFsharp library, specifically testing text rendering capabilities such as emoji support, no-break hyphens, ligatures, and external font usage within the PDF generation process. It includes utility functions for glyph verification and event-driven text processing to manipulate and analyze text before rendering.

classes.name: TextTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests verifying text rendering features like emoji support, hyphen management, ligatures, and font handling in PDFsharp.

classes.name: FontHelper
classes.description: A static helper class providing extension methods for font glyph verification.

methods.name: HasGlyph
methods.description: Extension method to check if a font contains glyphs for all characters in a given string.

methods.name: TextTests()
methods.description: Constructor initializing global font settings for tests.

methods.name: Dispose()
methods.description: Resets font management settings after tests.

methods.name: PDF_with_Emojis()
methods.description: Generates a PDF with emoji characters using colored glyphs.

methods.name: PDF_with_No_Break_Hyphen()
methods.description: Creates a PDF demonstrating hyphen replacement and content stream analysis.

methods.name: PDF_with_Wingdings()
methods.description: Creates a PDF using Wingdings font to illustrate glyph fallback and missing glyph handling.

methods.name: PDF_with_ligatures_text_event()
methods.description: Generates a PDF with ligature processing using text prepare events.

methods.name: PDF_with_ligatures_render_event()
methods.description: Generates a PDF with ligature replacement during text rendering via render events.
